en.headline: Lee says Tenant Purchase Scheme still has problems to study
en.dek: On a radio phone-in, the Chief Executive said about 15 per cent of flats in the 39 estates remain unsold and asked the Housing Bureau to keep examining the plan.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Thursday that the Tenant Purchase Scheme still has unresolved problems and that the government has asked the Housing Bureau to keep studying how to handle it, including the unsold flats.

Speaking on a radio phone-in after a public housing resident asked the government to revive the scheme, Lee said about 15 per cent of units across the 39 participating estates have never been sold. He said consultation and internal work had produced both support and opposition, and that pricing and estate management remain difficulties.

Lee said the government had not abandoned the scheme, but wanted measures that help the largest number of people. He repeated that Home Ownership Scheme and Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme sales have clearer pricing and stronger take-up. Separate remarks after Wednesday’s Policy Address put the unsold stock at about 28,000 flats.

A caller also raised owners’ corporation proxy votes after the Wang Fuk Court fire. Lee said the issue needed study so that controls were reasonable, and that the government would do more on law, management and systems after the independent committee reports.

zh.headline: 李家超：租置計劃仍有問題 房屋局繼續研究
zh.dek: 特首在電台節目表示，39個租置屋邨仍有約一成半單位未售出，已要求房屋局研究如何處理，包括未賣出單位。
body: 行政長官李家超周四在電台聯播節目表示，租者置其屋計劃仍有問題有待處理，政府已要求房屋局繼續研究，包括尚未售出的單位。
有公屋居民來電希望政府重推租置計劃。李家超回應指，計劃推出多年，39個屋邨仍有約15%單位未售出，諮詢及內部研究後有支持亦有反對意見，定價及屋邨管理亦存在問題。
他強調政府沒有放棄這個計劃，但希望措施能聚焦幫助絕大部分市民。他早前亦指出，居屋及綠置居認購較清晰，而租置單位未售出的數量約為2.8萬個。
另有聽眾提及宏福苑大火後業主大會授權票的問題。李家超說需要研究做到合理管控，並指獨立委員會提交報告後，政府會在法律、管理及制度上再做工作。
